name: memory_free
description: memory available without swapping is below an amount
command: if [ -r /proc/meminfo ]; then kb=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ { print $2 }' /proc/meminfo); else kb=$(vm_stat | awk '/page size of/ { for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "of") size = $(i + 1) } /^Pages (free|inactive|speculative|purgeable):/ { gsub(/[.]/, "", $NF); pages += $NF } END { printf "%d", pages * size / 1024 }'); fi; awk -v kb="$kb" -v lim="$BELOW_GB" 'BEGIN { if (kb + 0 <= 0) exit 2; gb = kb / 1048576; print sprintf("%.1f GB of memory available", gb); exit !(gb < lim) }'
text: When free memory is below $BELOW_GB GB
